rationale: The canonical Uni-CLI command calls the same Semantic Scholar Graph citations endpoint, accepts the reference identifier forms, and exposes the same bounded limit and offset pagination contract.

The canonical Uni-CLI command resolves the same Semantic Scholar paper identifiers through the Graph paper-detail endpoint and returns normalized citation, reference, author, external-id, and open-access metadata.

The Uni-CLI command calls the same Recommendations v1 forpaper endpoint with the same 1–500 bound and adds explicit recent/all-cs pool selection, structured provider errors, and stable scholarly row normalization.
The canonical Uni-CLI command performs the same free-text Semantic Scholar Graph search with an explicit 1–100 result bound and normalized scholarly records.
